repeats.disposition: The Siege source repeats the prelude original. Keep its first canonical occurrence once, with no duplicate imported original.

exclusions.reason: All other character arcs, anthology/handbook companions, one-shots, and optional runs outside the expressly selected backbone and supporting-comic boundary. The bridge page is audit evidence, not imported reading.
Keep the six main interleaved originals only; exclude the optional prologue and extended X-Men tie-ins. Preserve the complete existing Utopia guide unchanged.

Outside the selected Avengers/Thunderbolts and essential Asgard story boundary. The obsolete Fallen reference is independently identified as Sentry: Fallen Sun but is not added. Embedded #5 from the trade blurb is not an original in the issue sequence or independent bibliography.
Outside this essential selection; only Siege: Loki is selected for the Asgard thread.

placement.rationale: Owner-approved event-year placement for the 2010 Siege; the explicitly labeled Dark Reign prelude begins in 2008 and includes late setup released in 2010. Existing 2010 stories keep their relative order.

editorial.name: Siege: Dark Reign Prelude and Essential Tie-Ins
editorial.description: Norman Osborn's rise and fall, from a Dark Reign prelude beginning in 2008 to the 2010 Siege of Asgard. Follow Dark Avengers, New Avengers, Mighty Avengers, Avengers: The Initiative and Thunderbolts, with the complete four-issue Siege event and selected crossover chapters. The prelude includes the Deadpool/Thunderbolts crossover and Utopia; the event finishes with New Avengers Finale.
groups: Dark Reign prelude: Avengers and Thunderbolts
